profile.headline: Software Engineer at Kinray, LLC.
profile.geoLocationName: Queens County, New York, United States
profile.summary:
iSeries (AS400) expert with over 20 years of experience in development and support for the various applications including price modeling, inventory analysis, order entry, billing management and EDI solutions at Pharmaceutical wholesaler, Telecom, Shipping and Logistic industries

Expertise with all the versions of RPGLE, COBOL, CLLE, DB2, Query, iSeries for SQL, Stored procedure and MQ Series as well as strong working knowledge of MS SQL Server, Reporting Service (SSRS), Integration Service (SSIS), and object-oriented programming(OOP) such as Java and JavaScript

Highly dedicated to perform the root cause analysis, 24/7 application monitoring and support, delivering permanent solutions in a timely manner and identifying enhancement opportunities

Excellent team player recognized to develop and grow relationships with various parties as well as to learn quickly and to provide dependability, dedication, and initiative to job

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Kinray, a Cardinal Health Company, is a wholesaler of pharmaceutical products for drugs and health care.

Leading developer for delivery of high-quality business applications on a committed timeline and maintain optimal software integrity, continuity, and efficiency.
•	Work with users/third parties to determine problem solutions and corrective actions for requirements using Visio, design databases, develop applications, evaluate, implement and supporting applications in accordance with Agile written in RPGLE, CLLE, embedded SQL and SQL/PSM.

•	Successfully delivered the major cooperative projects as a leading developer such as exchanging manifest data with carriers in XML/EDI format thru MFT using AXWAY, Paperless Directed Picking System with Q/C, thresholder monitoring of controlled substances for ADC (Anti Diversion Control), drug supply data tracing thru MQ for the FDA compliance and Logistics Solutions in line with the company’s strategy for the high satisfaction of all the stakeholders.

•	Engaged in enhancement/maintenance various modules for the finance package from On-line Solution Inc. i.e., E-credits posting on statements to be reflected into the accurate aging period, A/R credit and balance reports and distribution related programs. 

•	Designed, developed and successfully deployed a new integrated CDM (Customer Data Module) provide data exchanges for all data types managed by tables as setup master and transactions sets that satisfies individual customers’ specific data requirements and allow user to build customized segments of X12 transaction sets for 832 – Price change, 855 – PO Acknowledgement and 810 – Invoice as well as private formats and XML through SFTP and MQ series sending a grouped messages or stream files.

•	Technical Environment:
o	iSeries RPGIII, RPGILE, RPG Free, CLLE, SQL/PSM, Query, DFU/RLU/SDA, IBM RDP (Rational Developer for Power Systems), DBU, MQ Series, Hawkeye, ROBOT

positions.title: Senior Programmer Analyst
positions.description:
Rogers Communications is one of leading diversified public communications and media providers. 
Responsible for application development/maintenance for the billing systems i.e., receiving data from various networks, billing rating, generating invoices, and transferring data to the multiple platforms such as AS400, HP UNIX and NT servers.

•	Proactively conducted a problem analysis, performed advanced troubleshooting, and delivered permanent solutions for various applications to ensure 24/7 system availability.

•	Delivered problem analysis, development and implementation for enhancements and new functionalities written in COBOL, RPG400, ILE and RPG Free as well as embedded SQL.

•	Analyzed user requirements, provide various type of reports using Query and SQL and extract data from DB2 taking into consideration interfaces with other systems including Excel, Access, and SQL Server.

•	Involved in the design, development and testing for medium and large size of projects such as Editing and Rating, Local Services Billing, Account Management System, Year 2000 project, etc.

•	Supporting MS Great Plains on MS/SQL Server, Order Entry/Order Management and Siebel 6.x customer care solution on Oracle Database with AS400 billing system to ensure effective interface and data consistency between AS400 and the associated distributed systems.

•	Technical Environment:
o	AS400:  RPG/400, RPGILE, RPG Free, COBOL, C, CLP, SQL/PSM, Query, MQSeries, DFU/RLU/SDA, ROBOT, HWAKEYE, MKS Implementer
o	HP UNIX Script,  Java, Oracle PL/SQL, Crystal Report, MS Access, SQL server
